localKey.revokeTitle: Revoke the signing key on this machine

localKey.revokeDetail: Their code-running connections (MCP, CLI, tools, hooks, services, extensions, web apps, launchers, bridges, VS Code) turn off and cannot be turned on until each package is rebuilt with the new key and approved again.
